name: cloud-r2pan
description: cloud-r2pan - iOS 26 液态玻璃风格网盘分享系统 (Cloudflare Workers + R2 + D1)

scripts.test: esbuild "test/*.ts" --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outdir=.dev/test --out-extension:.js=.mjs --log-level=warning && node --input-type=module -e "import fs from 'node:fs'; import url from 'node:url'; const files=fs.readdirSync('.dev/test').filter(f=>f.endsWith('.mjs')); if(!files.length) throw new Error('no test bundles emitted'); for (const f of files) await import(url.pathToFileURL('.dev/test/' + f).href)"
